{{Top|leg}}
'''Squad 223: Mission Zero''' was a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] circulating during the [[Great Galactic War]]. A story about heroic [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] fighting villains, the holovid made a big impression on [[Felix Iresso]] as a child, and later inspired him to join the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].
